description: 斜面手机座，带充电线开槽，可放横竖屏
description_en: Angled phone dock with charging cable slot, holds portrait or landscape
code:
import cadquery as cq

# === 参数 ===
base_w = 80      # 底座宽 (mm)
base_d = 70      # 底座深 (mm)
base_t = 8       # 底座厚 (mm)
lip_h = 20       # 前挡边高 (mm)
slot_w = 12      # 手机槽宽 (放手机厚度) (mm)
lean = 15        # 靠背倾角 (度)
cable_d = 12     # 充电线开口 (mm)

# === 底座 ===
result = cq.Workplane("XY").box(base_w, base_d, base_t, centered=(True, True, False))

# === 前挡边 (托住手机底部) ===
lip = cq.Workplane("XY").box(base_w, 6, base_t + lip_h, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((0, base_d/2 - 3, 0))
result = result.union(lip)

# === 靠背 (斜面支撑) ===
back = (
    cq.Workplane("XZ")
    .moveTo(-base_w/2, base_t)
    .lineTo(base_w/2, base_t)
    .lineTo(base_w/2, base_t + 55)
    .lineTo(-base_w/2, base_t + 55)
    .close()
    .extrude(8)
    .rotate((0,0,0),(1,0,0), -lean)
    .translate((0, -base_d/2 + 10, 0))
)
result = result.union(back)

# === 手机槽 + 充电线开口 ===
slot = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=base_t).box(slot_w*4, slot_w, lip_h*2, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((0, base_d/2 - 10, 0))
result = result.cut(slot)
cable = cq.Workplane("XY").workplane(offset=base_t).box(cable_d, 40, cable_d, centered=(True, True, False)).translate((0, base_d/2 - 10, 0))
result = result.cut(cable)

result = result.edges("|Z").fillet(3)

show_object(result)
